create_folder.description: Make a Gofile folder to collect files in and share with one link, with an optional password, description, tags and expiry date.

mock_response.description: Made by Lodol's **QA** workflow. Safe to delete.
mock_response.name: Lodol QA 0afe63

create_folder.name: create_folder

parameters.description: What to call the folder. Leave empty for a random name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Whether anyone with the folder's link can open it, or only this Gofile account.
parameters.name: sharing

parameters.description: Visitors must type this before they can open the folder: 4 to 100 letters, numbers and symbols, with no spaces.
parameters.name: password

parameters.description: When the folder stops being available. On a free Gofile account the folder and everything in it are then deleted for good; on Premium only its link stops working.
parameters.name: expires_at

parameters.description: Text shown on the folder's page to everyone who opens it, up to 2,000 characters. Formatting such as **bold** works.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Labels to sort it by, separated by commas, such as invoices, 2026. Each is up to 25 letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. They replace any tags it had.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: The folder to create it in: its folder ID. Leave empty to create it at the top of the account.
parameters.name: parent_folder

description.description: The folder's description. Null when it has none.

expires_at.description: When the folder expires, e.g. 2026-10-17T02:47:54Z. Null when it doesn't.

folder_id.description: The folder's ID, for Upload a file, Update a folder and Delete files or folders to use this folder.

is_public.description: Whether anyone with the link can open it.

parent_folder_id.description: The ID of the folder it was created in.

share_url.description: The folder's page, e.g. https://gofile.io/d/OTOOvwKY. It opens for anyone while the folder is shared with anyone with the link.

delete_items.description: Delete files and folders from Gofile, a folder with everything in it. Unless the account's recycle bin is turned on, this can't be undone.
delete_items.name: delete_items

parameters.description: The ID of the file or folder to delete, from Upload a file or Create a folder. To delete several at once, separate their IDs with commas.
parameters.name: items

already_gone.description: IDs Gofile had nothing for: already deleted, or expired.

deleted.description: The IDs of the files and folders deleted.

deleted_count.description: How many files and folders were deleted.

get_account.description: See the connected Gofile account: its type, its main folder, and how many files and folders it holds and how much space they use.
get_account.name: get_account

account_type_label.description: The account type in words: Guest account, Standard account or Premium account.

created_at.description: When the account was created, e.g. 2026-10-16T02:07:02Z.

email.description: The account's email address. Null for a guest account.

file_count.description: How many files the account holds.

folder_count.description: How many folders the account holds.

is_guest.description: Whether it is a guest account, which nobody signs in to: its files are opened through their links.

name.description: The account's email address, or Guest and a number for a guest account.

root_folder_id.description: The ID of the account's main folder, which holds everything else. Only the account can open it.

storage_used.description: The space the files take, e.g. 2.5 MB.

storage_used_bytes.description: The space the files take, in bytes.

update_file.description: Rename a file on Gofile or change its tags. Its link stays the same.
update_file.name: update_file

parameters.description: The file to change: its file ID, which Upload a file returns.
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: A new name for the file, extension included.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Labels to sort it by, separated by commas, such as invoices, 2026. Each is up to 25 letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. They replace any tags it had.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: Take every tag off the file.
parameters.name: remove_tags

changes.description: What this step changed, in order, as short phrases such as 'password set' or 'tags removed'.

content_type.description: The kind of file, e.g. application/pdf or image/png.

file_id.description: The file's ID, which Update a file and Delete files or folders take.

folder_id.description: The ID of the folder the file is in.

name.description: The file's name after the changes.

share_url.description: The file's page, where it can be viewed and downloaded. It opens for anyone while the file's folder is shared with anyone with the link.

size.description: The file's size as a person reads it, e.g. 13.3 KB.

size_bytes.description: The file's size in bytes, e.g. 13264.

tags.description: The file's tags after the changes. Null when this step left them as they were.

update_folder.description: Change a Gofile folder's name, who can open it, its password, expiry date, description or tags, or remove any of them. Settings left empty stay as they are.

changes: only this account can open it
mock_response.name: Lodol QA 0afe63 (private)

update_folder.name: update_folder

parameters.description: The folder to change: its folder ID, which Create a folder and Upload a file return.
parameters.name: folder

parameters.description: A new name for the folder.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Open the folder to anyone with its link, make it private to this Gofile account, or leave it as it is.
parameters.name: sharing

parameters.description: Visitors must type this before they can open the folder: 4 to 100 letters, numbers and symbols, with no spaces.
parameters.name: password

parameters.description: When the folder stops being available. On a free Gofile account the folder and everything in it are then deleted for good; on Premium only its link stops working.
parameters.name: expires_at

parameters.description: Text shown on the folder's page to everyone who opens it, up to 2,000 characters. Formatting such as **bold** works.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Labels to sort it by, separated by commas, such as invoices, 2026. Each is up to 25 letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. They replace any tags it had.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: Settings to take off the folder.
parameters.name: remove

changes.description: What this step changed, in order, as short phrases such as 'password set' or 'tags removed'.

expires_at.description: The new expiry time, e.g. 2026-10-18T02:47:54Z. Null when this step didn't set one.

folder_id.description: The folder's ID, for Upload a file, Update a folder and Delete files or folders to use this folder.

is_public.description: Whether anyone with the link can now open it. Null when this step left it as it was.

name.description: The folder's name after the changes.

password_protected.description: Whether visitors now need a password. Null when this step left it as it was.

share_url.description: The folder's page, e.g. https://gofile.io/d/OTOOvwKY. It opens for anyone while the folder is shared with anyone with the link.

upload_file.description: Put a file on Gofile and get a link anyone can open to view and download it. The file goes into a new folder of its own unless you choose one.
upload_file.name: upload_file

parameters.description: The file to upload: upload one, pick one from an earlier step, or paste a public link to one (up to 100 MB from a link).
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: What to call the file on Gofile. Leave empty to keep its own name; if you leave off the extension, the file's own is added.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The folder to put the file in: its folder ID, from Create a folder or an earlier upload. Leave empty to put the file in a new folder that anyone with the link can open.
parameters.name: folder

content_type.description: The kind of file, e.g. application/pdf or image/png.

file_id.description: The file's ID, which Update a file and Delete files or folders take.

folder_id.description: The ID of the folder the file is in. Give it to the next Upload a file to add more files to the same folder, or to Update a folder to protect it.

folder_share_url.description: The page of the folder the file is in, listing everything in it, e.g. https://gofile.io/d/s5FWR7xy.

share_url.description: The file's page, where it can be viewed and downloaded, e.g. https://gofile.io/d/BOT1eEeE. It opens for anyone while the file's folder is shared with anyone with the link, as a new folder is.

size.description: The file's size as a person reads it, e.g. 13.3 KB.

size_bytes.description: The file's size in bytes, e.g. 13264.

description: Share files with Gofile, the free file host: upload a file and get a link anyone can open, keep files together in folders, and protect a folder with a password or have it expire on a date. Works without a Gofile account, or with your own.
